---
title: "SDP_Simulate"
format: html
---

```{r Packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(scico)
library(patchwork)
library(LaplacesDemon)
```

```{r LoadData}
swpa_model <- read_rds("2_Model/Outputs/Species/Swift Parrot.rds")
D <- swpa_model$D
transitions_pop <- swpa_model$transitions_pop
transitions_disease <- swpa_model$arguments$disease_transitions
```

```{r StateSpace}
state_space <- expand.grid(Nw = 1:41,
                           Nc = 1:21,
                           Exposure = 1:6,
                           Month = 1:12) |>
  mutate(Action = NA)

for (i in 1:nrow(state_space)){
  state_space$Action[i] <- D[state_space$Nw[i],
                             state_space$Nc[i],
                             state_space$Exposure[i],
                             state_space$Month[i]]
}

state_space |>
  mutate(Month = recode_values(Month, 
                               from = 1:12, to = month.abb)) |>
  mutate(Month = fct(Month, levels = month.abb)) |>
  mutate(Exposure = recode_values(Exposure,
                                  1 ~ "No cases",
                                  2 ~ ">3000km",
                                  3 ~ "1000-3000km",
                                  4 ~ "100-1000km",
                                  5 ~ "In Region",
                                  6 ~ "Infected")) |>
  mutate(Exposure = fct(Exposure)) |>
  mutate(Nc = (Nc*50)-50,
         Nw = (Nw*50)-50) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Nc, y = Nw, fill = Action)) +
  geom_tile() + 
  coord_equal() +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Exposure), 
             cols = vars(Month), switch = "y") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), position = "right") +
  scale_fill_scico(palette = 'vik', midpoint = 0) +
  labs(x = "Captive Population", y = "Wild Population") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 70, 
                                   hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
                                   colour = "white"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "white"),
        axis.title = element_text(colour = "white"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "white"),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "gray20"), 
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "gray20"),
        legend.text = element_text(colour = "white"),
        legend.title = element_text(colour = "white"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90"))
```

```{r Simulate flu}
timesteps <- swpa_model$arguments$Tmax
fluDf <- data.frame(timestep = 1:timesteps,
                    fluState = NA)
fluDf$fluState[1] <- 4
for (t in 2:timesteps){
  fluDf$fluState[t] <- rcat(1, transitions_disease[fluDf$fluState[t-1],])
}

flu_plot <- fluDf |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = timestep, y = fluState)) +
  geom_line(colour = "gray60") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = fct(as.character(fluState)))) +
  scale_colour_manual(limits = c("1","2","3","4","5","6"),
                      values = c("gray80", rep("goldenrod2",4), "indianred4"))
```

```{r Simulate decisions}
Tmonths <- rep_len(c(swpa_model$arguments$breeding_month:12,
                     1:(swpa_model$arguments$breeding_month-1)),
                   length.out = swpa_model$arguments$Tmax)
timesteps_months <- Tmonths[1:timesteps]
actions <- seq(-100, 100, by = 5)

phi_wc <- swpa_model$arguments$phi_wc
establish_cost <- swpa_model$arguments$establish_cost
captive_cost <- swpa_model$arguments$captive_cost
cw_translocate_cost <- swpa_model$arguments$cw_translocate_cost
wc_translocate_cost <- swpa_model$arguments$wc_translocate_cost

get_cost <- function(lastWildPop, 
                     lastCaptivePop, 
                     action){
  
  tau_cw <- ifelse(action > 0, action, 0)/100
  tau_wc <- ifelse(action < 0, abs(action), 0)/100
  
  if (lastCaptivePop == 1 & tau_wc > 0){
    setupCost <- establish_cost
  } else {
    setupCost <- 0
  }

  costUtility <- (((lastCaptivePop-1)-((lastCaptivePop-1)*(tau_cw)) +
                     ((lastWildPop-1)*tau_wc))*captive_cost) +
    (((lastCaptivePop-1)*tau_cw)*cw_translocate_cost)+
    (((lastWildPop-1)*tau_wc)*wc_translocate_cost) +
    (setupCost)
  
  
  return(costUtility)
}

popTraject <- data.frame(timestep = 1:timesteps,
                         Nw = NA,
                         Nc = NA,
                         exposure = NA,
                         month = NA,
                         Action = NA,
                         Cost = NA)
popTraject[1,] <- data.frame(timestep = 1,
                             Nw = 16, 
                             Nc = 1, 
                             exposure = 4,
                             month = 10, 
                             Action = D[16,1,4,10],
                             Cost = get_cost(16, 1, D[16,1,4,10]))

for (t in 2:timesteps){
  
  nextPop <- rcat(n = 1,
                  as.vector(transitions_pop[popTraject$Nw[t-1],
                                  popTraject$Nc[t-1],
                                  ,
                                  ,
                                  ifelse(popTraject$exposure[t-1]==6, 2, 1),
                                  ifelse(popTraject$month[t-1]==10, 2, 1),
                                  which(actions == popTraject$Action[t-1])]))
  
  popIndex <- arrayInd(nextPop, .dim = c(41,21))
  
  popTraject$Nw[t] <- popIndex[1,1]
  popTraject$Nc[t] <- popIndex[1,2]
  
  popTraject$exposure[t] <- fluDf$fluState[t]
  popTraject$month[t] <- timesteps_months[t]
  popTraject$Action[t] <- D[popTraject$Nw[t],
                            popTraject$Nc[t],
                            popTraject$exposure[t],
                            popTraject$month[t]]
  popTraject$Cost[t] <- get_cost(popTraject$Nw[t-1],
                                 popTraject$Nc[t-1],
                                 popTraject$Action[t])
}


pop_plot <- popTraject |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Nw, Nc), names_to = "group", values_to = "pop") |>
  mutate(pop = (pop*50)-50) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = timestep, y = pop, fill = group)) +
  geom_col()

cost_plot <- popTraject |> 
  mutate(Cost = cumsum(Cost)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = timestep, y = Cost)) +
  geom_line(colour = "goldenrod4")

action_plot <- popTraject |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = timestep, y = Action)) +
  geom_line()

pop_plot/action_plot/flu_plot/cost_plot +
  plot_layout(axes = "collect")
```
